briefdescription.para: RAII wrapper classes for resource management in LLM module.

detaileddescription.para:
0.0.1
Batch 2: RAII & Resource Management Fixes
Provides exception-safe RAII wrappers for:
OpenSSL objects (BIO, EVP_PKEY, EVP_MD_CTX)
File handles
Database connections
GPU memory allocations
All wrappers are move-enabled and exception-safe (noexcept destructors). This replaces manual delete/cleanup patterns with automatic resource management.
